counterargs.read: This is a genuinely two-sided setup into tomorrow's CPI. Oil's persistent rally is finally bleeding into breakeven inflation expectations — the confirmation that was missing as of yesterday's read — but nominal yields and equity vol haven't moved to price real stress, and credit and Korea risk gauges are actually improving, not deteriorating. A hot CPI print would likely resolve this toward the inflation-reacceleration case; a soft print would let the market treat the oil move as noise and support a continuation of the otherwise calm, credit-constructive backdrop.
